name: zolva-videos

scripts.render:q1: remotion render src/index.ts Q1 out/zolva-q1-1920x1080.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:crypto-live: remotion render src/index.ts CryptoLive out/zolva-crypto-live-1920x1080.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:record: remotion render src/index.ts RecordVideo out/zolva-record-11-days-1920x1080.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:crypto-beat: remotion render src/index.ts CryptoBeat out/zolva-crypto-beat-1920x1080.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
